original_value: PCIe Performance at an Affordable Price, 512GB, PCIe 3.0 x4, M.2 2280 M.2 Internal Solid State Drive, QLC 3D NAND, Up to 1500MB/s Read, Up to 1000MB/s Write, Random performance of up to 90K/220K R/W IOPS, 5 year warranty

result.paraphrase: Affordable PCIe performance with 512GB capacity: an internal M.2 2280 solid state drive using PCIe 3.0 x4 and QLC 3D NAND. Offers up to 1500MB/s read speed, up to 1000MB/s write speed, random performance up to 90K/220K R/W IOPS, and a 5 year warranty.
